reviews.review: It is (at least in some MP servers) a big walking simulator. But it honestly makes the fight far more satisfying experience

Amazing game, I have these 700 hours divided between 'Antistasi Ultimate',' Impasse Total War' and 'Dynamic CAS Ops', with the former being my most played.
The game still has an alive and healty modding scene, which is filled with amazingly talented modders that can introduce completely new and innovative mechanics even a decade after launch.
The game has a lot of content already, but the aforementioned modders have filled the game with equipment from many countries, big and small, real and fictional; and from different historical eras, from 14th century to ww1, ww2, cold war, vietnam war, modern times, 2035 and even up to the fortieth millennia. 
My only gripe is that the optimization is not very good, on some maps FPS can dip down into the 20-30s. It can be an issue I admit, but fortunately it is a rather slow-paced game so most of the time it is not an issue... unless you're a pilot - but you can get used to it.

Played a bunch of KOTH on code four gaming. Enjoyed my time mostly, despite the constant lag and disconnects. Couldn't find many servers with good ping. In fact all of them appear to have hundreds of ping despite being close to me geographically. I feel like it wasn't like this in the past. I remember playing with a good connection before. Unfortunately I just can't recommend the game as there are not really any good servers with good ping anymore.
